entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: MR P P MAJMUDAR, ADVOCATE for the Petitioner(s) No. 1 - 2

===================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE N.V.ANJARIA  Date : 05/04/2016  ORAL ORDER

Learned advocate Mr. Nishit Gandhi for learned advocate Mr. P. P. Majmudar on instructions from the petitioners, does not press the present petition, stating further that the petitioner would prefer to make a fresh application for obtaining the registration under the Food Safety Standards Act,
2006.
Permission, as prayed for, is granted.
The petition stands disposed of with the liberty as prayed for to make necessary application.
If such an application is made, the authority concerned shall consider the same strictly in accordance with provisions of the Act and the rules.
